audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Jax, Jax, Jax, Skill, Jax, Skill, Jax. It contradicts the packet chart AND its own prose: whys[0] calls Level 1 'even-ish', whys[3] says your dodge-stun punishes every step (Jax), whys[5] says force the all-in now (Jax), whys[6] says past two items the lane is hers (Kayle).
audit.why: A 55.98% win rate over a Kayle who is melee until level 11 cannot show Jax losing Levels 4-5 and first item, and cannot show Jax winning at 2+ items against Exalted form.
audit.corrected: phases/win rows 0 = Skill, 3 = Jax, 5 = Jax, 6 = Kayle, with ratings moved to match, proposed as one atomic group across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kayle's spikes were listed as 'Divine Judgment online, level 6, first item' with no cooldown numbers anywhere.
audit.why: Her real spikes are level 11 (permanent ranged Exalted form) and level 16, not level 6. Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s — at rank 1 baiting it buys you a full two-and-a-half minutes, which is the concrete reason to bait rather than a slogan.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns: Divine Judgment 160s at rank 1, Radiant Blast 12s at rank 1, Celestial Blessing 15s flat, Counter Strike 17s.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] 'Key Ability Interactions' named only Divine Judgment and reduced the matchup to 'bait it'. The packet flags that the page never names Radiant Blast, Celestial Blessing or Starfire Spellblade.
audit.why: The decisive interaction is that Counter Strike dodges ATTACKS: it eats her autos and the Starfire Spellblade auto-reset, but Radiant Blast is a spell and lands through it — and Radiant Blast reduces your resistances, which is what makes her follow-up burst hurt. That is the interaction a player needs.
audit.corrected: report[5] rewritten to state Radiant Blast's 900-range slow and resist shred and that Counter Strike does not stop it.

audit.why: Celestial Blessing is a heal, so Executioner's Calling early in report[8] is right.
Voice and accuracy — the page is otherwise second-person and she is female.
audit.corrected: tradeGood and dontsFull[0].d rewritten; dontsFull[0].d also replaced with the real reason (she only needs XP to reach 11).

audit.why: 55.98% over 652 games; the EVEN diff label undersells it but sits inside the approved tolerance and diffRating 4/10 already reads favoured.
